contact-models-intro: Maximum transparency, absolute flexibility, and a steadfast focus on results.Every mandate and every project within the regulated healthcare sector is unique.To provide you with maximum planning certainty, we tailor our approach precisely to your specific needs.
contact-promise-body: We believe in the measurable success of our work. For complex restructuring mandates or large-scale sales projects, we offer—upon request—a hybrid pricing model:A reduced base daily rate, coupled with a clearly defined, performance-based component (Success Fee) triggered upon the achievement of your project milestones.
contact-quote-body: Every proposal is custom-tailored. During a free, 30-minute initial consultation, we will analyze your specific challenges and provide you with a transparent fixed-price or mandate-specific proposal within 48 hours.
contact-subtitle: Let us shed economic light on your care concepts, strategies, and structures.
offerings-roundtable_text: Neutral moderation and professional auditing of strategic "Round-Tables" at the interfaces between payers and healthcare providers.
offerings-contract_text: Independent auditing and review of care contracts both on the part of health insurance funds and for homecare structures.
offerings-interfaces_text: Evaluation of existing patient pathways to reduce systemic disruptions and consistently avoid misallocations.
offerings-commercial_li1: Vacancy Management: Interim coverage in team & regional management (Homecare & MedTech)
offerings-commercial_li2: Go-to-Market: Strategy & market positioning for medical goods (Wound/Aids)
offerings-commercial_li3: Market Analyses: Regulatory alignment (SGB vs. KLV/MiGeL)

offerings-digital_li2: Securing ROI: Change management to increase field acceptance
offerings-digital_li3: QM Design: Digital documentation synchronized with QM standards
offerings-outcome_li1: Medical Aid Audits: Technical review to detect misallocations and faulty care
offerings-outcome_li2: KPI Reporting: Measurement of real care outcomes (e.g., healing rates)
offerings-outcome_li3: Logistics Optimization: Evaluation of procurement structures & provider supply chains
offerings-diff_statement_text: Why our D-CH expertise makes the decisive difference:
offerings-diff_li1: 360-Degree Perspective: From the front line (care setting) up to the board of directors (payers).
offerings-diff_li2: Revenue Evidence: Validated successes in the D-CH homecare sector (wounds, nutrition, stoma, incontinence, etc.).
offerings-diff_li3: Outcome Orientation: Measurable savings instead of theoretical slide concepts.
offerings-diff_li4: Cost Research: Radical transparency for direct & indirect expenditures.
offerings-diff_li5: Implementation Guarantee: Guidance through the processes until a stable outcome is achieved.
